sections.content: You know *ser de* and *vivir en* from A1, and how to describe yourself with *ser*, *estar* and *tener*. This lesson uses them to talk about origin and belonging: *ser de* for origin, *vivir en* for where you live and *sentirse parte de* to say where you belong.

items.spanish: Soy de Sudáfrica, pero ahora vivo en Budapest.
items.english: I am from South Africa, but now I live in Budapest.

items.spanish: Me siento parte de esta comunidad.
items.english: I feel part of this community.

items.spanish: Mi origen forma parte de mi identidad.
items.english: My origin is part of my identity.

sections.content: Use *ser de* for origin, *vivir en* for residence and *sentirse parte de* to express belonging.
